$comment: Traceability manifest (directive §4.2). Requirement IDs are stable: never renumber; deprecate with status instead. check: scripts/check-conformance.mjs — every 'implemented' requirement must reference ≥1 existing test file that mentions the ID; 'specified' requires a justification. AS-WIRE-001..003 are intentionally unassigned: the pre-existing codec requirements are AS-ID-002 and AS-ID-004, and D30's proposed ids are kept as written rather than renumbered.

AS-INVOKE-001.title: Pre-input authority policies (onAuthorize) cannot observe agent input

AS-INVOKE-002.title: onInvoke policies receive only the validated effective input

AS-INVOKE-003.title: A malformed binding fails before a confirmation record is created

AS-INVOKE-004.title: A supplied locked field fails before a confirmation record is created

AS-INVOKE-005.title: Confirmation summary/input reflect bound (effective) values, including bindings that changed after discovery

AS-IDENT-001.title: Same consumer + same invocationId + same request joins in-flight exactly once / returns cached terminal

AS-IDENT-002.title: Same consumer + same invocationId + different input fails INVOCATION_CONFLICT

AS-IDENT-003.title: Same consumer + same invocationId + different capability fails INVOCATION_CONFLICT

AS-IDENT-004.title: Different consumers may reuse the same provider tool-call id safely

AS-IDENT-005.title: Expired dedupe key is a new attempt (bounded idempotency window, LRU + TTL, deterministic under fake clocks)

AS-IDENT-006.title: Confirmation retry reuses same invocationId + confirmationId and executes once; CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED / RATE_LIMITED / INVOCATION_CONFLICT are never cached as terminal

AS-CONFIRM-001.title: Approval binds to the canonical request digest; input changed after approval fails CONFIRMATION_INVALID(mismatch), never executes

AS-CONFIRM-002.title: Digest uses canonical JSON (key order irrelevant; -0 = 0; undefined omitted) and evidence matching is exact-value, never hash-only

AS-CONFIRM-003.title: Confirmation evidence is single-use; replay fails CONFIRMATION_INVALID(consumed)

AS-CONFIRM-004.title: Approval cannot be replayed across consumer, registration, or capability

AS-CONFIRM-005.title: Pending confirmations are bounded (maxPendingConfirmations); overflow fails RATE_LIMITED without creating a record

AS-NAV-001.title: Navigation commit + owner unmount in the same task settles ok (navigation-commit-then-owner-unmount)

AS-NAV-002.title: Navigation rejected before commit settles a typed failure (CANCELLED when aborted, else EXECUTION_FAILED)

AS-NAV-003.title: Owner unmounted before dispatch still fails COMPONENT_UNMOUNTED for navigation actions

AS-NAV-004.title: A timeout cannot overwrite an already-resolved navigation (no failure after router acceptance)

AS-OBS-001.title: Observation admission enforces independent per-consumer and global concurrency limits with a bounded FIFO queue; overflow fails RATE_LIMITED(queue-full)

AS-OBS-002.title: One saturated consumer cannot starve another consumer's observations

AS-OBS-003.title: Observation slots are released on settlement/cancellation/timeout and queues drain FIFO; disposal drains queues as CANCELLED

AS-TOPO-001.title: createAgentToolset throws when neither topology nor confirmations is provided (no ambiguous global default)

AS-TOPO-002.title: Topology defaults: embedded → wait, remote → two-phase; explicit confirmations overrides

AS-TOPO-003.title: toolset.dispose() deterministically settles in-flight wait-mode confirmation waits

AS-POLICY-001.title: Policy contexts expose the injectable clock (now()); built-in policies are deterministic under fake timers

AS-ERR-001.title: The agent-facing error enum, retry categories, and cacheability are cross-validated against spec/error-matrix.json from one source

AS-CONC-001.title: AgentConcurrency contract (instance | capability | key | parallel{max}) — default instance, bounded parallel, per-group queue depth

AS-ID-001.title: Canonical id grammar: accept/reject table for component types, capability names, instance ids; parsing unambiguous

AS-ID-002.title: Wire-name codec: reversible encoding, provider-safe alphabet, 56+hash truncation at 64 chars, per-instance disambiguation

AS-ID-003.title: Property: id parser/formatter round-trips for arbitrary grammar-valid ids

AS-ID-004.title: Property: wire-name codec round-trips within provider limits, stays in safe alphabet

AS-SCHEMA-001.title: D19 subset enforced at registration: allowlisted keywords only, depth/size caps, UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA otherwise

AS-SCHEMA-002.title: Standard Schema integration (Zod/Valibot) via fromStandardSchema with caller-supplied JSON Schema

AS-SCHEMA-003.title: Property: random allowlist schemas accepted; any forbidden keyword or excess depth rejected

AS-LIFE-001.title: Register/unregister lifecycle: live immediately, capabilities disappear on unregister, in-flight aborted

AS-LIFE-002.title: Structural immutability per registration: only enabled/availability updatable; structural defects always thrown

AS-LIFE-003.title: Collision handling: first-wins dead handle by default, replace mode aborts predecessor, capability dupes structural

AS-LIFE-004.title: Property: arbitrary register/unregister sequences preserve unique live identities and monotone versions

AS-LIFE-005.title: strict-mode-register-cleanup-register: remount yields new registrationId; stale id reports registration-replaced

AS-VER-001.title: surfaceVersion bump matrix: structural + pushed availability bump; handler swaps and lazy when() drift do not

AS-EVT-001.title: Event ordering (D17): total mutation order, post-mutation dispatch, listener isolation, queued non-reentrant nested mutations

AS-SNAP-001.title: snapshot() is synchronous, side-effect free, never runs read()

AS-SNAP-002.title: internal metadata never serialized into snapshots or agent-facing payloads

AS-SNAP-003.title: Deterministic snapshot ordering (priority, type, instanceId) and explicit budget truncation marker

AS-AVAIL-001.title: Availability recomputed at invocation (phase 3); enabling-state errors carry the descriptor reason

AS-AVAIL-002.title: Authority hides, state discloses: hidden is indistinguishable from nonexistent, disabled carries a reason

AS-POLICY-002.title: Discovery composition is most-restrictive-wins across registry -> component -> capability chains

AS-POLICY-003.title: Requirement 12: invocation re-runs the same per-consumer filter that shaped the snapshot (hidden => NOT_FOUND)

AS-POLICY-004.title: Built-in policies behave per docs/06: authenticated, hasPermission, tenantBoundary, environment, rateLimit, audit

AS-STALE-001.title: Staleness matrix: registrationId mismatch => replaced/reloaded, tombstone => COMPONENT_UNMOUNTED, multi-instance => AMBIGUOUS_INSTANCE

AS-STALE-002.title: surface-version-changes-before-destructive-call: version hint enforced only for destructive/external effects

AS-CONC-002.title: Actions serialize FIFO per component instance with bounded queue; overflow RATE_LIMITED(queue-full)

AS-CONC-011.title: timeout-with-late-resolution: TIMEOUT settles, late handler settlement audited, never overwrites

AS-CONC-012.title: external-cancel-before-queue-entry / external-cancel-while-queued settle CANCELLED without executing

AS-SER-001.title: JsonValue-only payloads: non-JSON outputs are defects (dev throw / prod EXECUTION_FAILED); size caps fail loudly

AS-CONFIRM-006.title: Pending re-request returns the same confirmationId; denial is never auto-retried; expiry restarts the cycle

AS-OBSV-001.title: Audit distinguishes queueWaitMs from executionMs on settled invocations

AS-OBSV-002.title: The development console audit sink writes to the diagnostic stream, never stdout

AS-BOUND-001.title: Tombstones are TTL- and size-bounded; expiry decays COMPONENT_UNMOUNTED to CAPABILITY_NOT_FOUND deterministically

AS-BOUND-002.title: Dedupe cache evicts deterministically (LRU size + TTL) under a fake clock

AS-ADAPTER-001.title: Toolset attaches registrationId+surfaceVersion, maps toolCallId to invocationId, refreshes per version, unique wire names

AS-ADAPTER-002.title: Result envelopes relayed losslessly (code/retry/details preserved) through the toolset

AS-ADAPTER-003.title: WebMCP adapter: feature-detects, registers only available capabilities, refreshes on surface-changed

AS-ADAPTER-004.title: Meta mode resolves targets exactly as direct mode (ambiguity, not-found, unmounted, validation, confirmation)

AS-ADAPTER-005.title: Adapter-configured scope is a floor: a model-supplied scope narrows, never widens

AS-REACT-001.title: Commit-phase registration with Strict Mode symmetry (register/cleanup/register)

AS-REACT-002.title: Latest-ref handler freshness: handlers read current state at invocation without re-registration

AS-REACT-003.title: Availability pushed on when() flip so React surfaces stay event-driven

AS-REACT-004.title: usePendingConfirmations reflects the live pending set for host dialogs

AS-BIND-001.title: Schema surgery: agent-facing schema = original minus locked keys (partial/all/none bound, required handling)

AS-BIND-002.title: Locked-by-default binding: supplied locked fields INVALID_INPUT; overridable fields act as defaults; merged input revalidated against the full schema

AS-BIND-003.title: Exposure gating: refs absent from the manifest register nothing; the manifest is the ceiling

AS-BIND-004.title: useAgentProcedure lifecycle mirrors useAgentComponent; bind/when/describe read through the latest ref

AS-TEST-001.title: The testing package is the reference consumer: invoke/observe/captureRef/as, hidden-vs-disabled matchers, normalized semantic snapshots

AS-EXAMPLE-001.title: The devices scenario runs end to end, scripted, without an LLM (behavioral acceptance artifact)

AS-CACHE-001.title: Live state is absent from AgentTool.description

AS-CACHE-002.title: Provider-facing tool definitions (name, description, inputSchema) are byte-identical across snapshots differing only in availability or contextual note

AS-CACHE-003.title: AgentTool.state.note carries the procedure binding describe() contribution

AS-CACHE-004.title: AgentProcedureDescriptor.description is always free of contextual text; contextualNote carries it

AS-META-001.title: A model-supplied scope narrows the configured floor and never widens it

AS-META-002.title: A disjoint requested scope yields an empty surface, never a fallback to the floor

AS-META-003.title: Budget truncation sets the truncated marker in the payload the model reads and leaves surface_discover output a valid snapshot

AS-META-004.title: surface_act enforces the same confirmation and staleness semantics as the equivalent direct tool

AS-META-005.title: Meta-mode tool-block size is invariant in the number of registered capabilities

AS-META-006.title: A scope floor that refuses requested prefixes marks them in the discover payload, so an empty result is distinguishable from an empty surface

AS-META-007.title: Each meta verb enforces its own declared schema before the registry sees the call: a missing capabilityId or an unknown top-level key returns INVALID_INPUT naming it, never a pipeline failure

AS-META-008.title: surface_act declares input as an object and repairs a JSON-encoded one only when the target's own schema is an object, so a declared string input arrives unparsed

AS-WIRE-004.title: Emitted wire names never exceed the 64-character provider budget

AS-WIRE-005.title: Wire-name assignment is deterministic across snapshots and independent of entry order

AS-WIRE-006.title: No two entries in one emitted catalog share a wire name

AS-WIRE-007.title: wireNameMap() round-trips every emitted name; decodeWireName returns undefined rather than a wrong canonical id

AS-EXPLAIN-001.title: explainSurface() reports capabilities the snapshot hides, and names the policy that hid them

AS-EXPLAIN-002.title: Every policy in the chain is attributed by name and by scope (registry/component/capability)

AS-EXPLAIN-003.title: The explanation's composed outcome always agrees with the snapshot for the same context

AS-EXPLAIN-004.title: explainSurface is unreachable from the package root that adapters import

AS-CLI-001.title: The rendered inspect view contains every capability the snapshot contains

AS-CLI-002.title: Exit codes are 0 clean, 1 a finding, 2 the command could not run — and check is the only command that fails on a finding

AS-CLI-003.title: Piped, --plain, CI and NO_COLOR output is plain text and byte-stable across runs

AS-CLI-004.title: stdout carries only the command's output, so --json parses whatever the mounted app logs

AS-CLI-005.title: The command exits even when the mounted app leaves the event loop busy, naming the held handles

AS-CLI-006.title: Registrations rejected during a mount appear in inspect output and JSON, and fail check

AS-CLI-007.title: Counts are never printed without their qualifier: the scenario, any active scope, and the hidden capabilities themselves

AS-CLI-008.title: --depth selects which halves are computed, and every command reports which ones it did not

AS-CLI-009.title: One normalized, deterministic scenario report feeds JSON, baselines and check; it always includes hidden capabilities while detail adds attribution only

AS-CLI-010.title: Committed baselines include a scenario manifest; removed and stale scenarios fail check; unread baseline data exits 2; scenario names cannot escape baselineDir

AS-CLI-011.title: Full depth consumes an authoritative oRPC manifest as the domain denominator and applies effective config or CLI scope to every plane

AS-CLI-012.title: Human output leads with a verdict, groups complete static results compactly, and reserves raw origins and non-gating inventories for --detail

AS-CLI-013.title: A report opens with the run it describes and the summary it produced — the catalog, the per-scenario tables and every other detail follow it

AS-CLI-014.title: Every command renders one report model through one presenter: the same blocks, findings and label grid, drawn by the terminal UI or by plain text per stream

AS-COVER-001.title: Every statically resolvable registration call site in the analyzed program appears in the catalog

AS-COVER-002.title: A registration the extractor cannot fully enumerate is emitted with resolution "unresolved" and an origin — never absent from both the catalog and the unread list

AS-COVER-003.title: check exits non-zero when any call site is unread and --allow-unresolved was not passed

AS-COVER-004.title: A policy-hidden capability is classified reached, because a scenario mounted it

AS-COVER-005.title: Coverage exit codes mirror AS-CLI-002, and a stale allowlist entry fails the command

AS-COVER-006.title: The static catalog is never reachable from the agent-facing package root

AS-COVER-007.title: The authored-minus-reached gap reaches inspect, snapshot and check; a scope filters the catalog by the same predicate as the mount; and a scenario that did not mount yields no verdict at all

AS-COVER-008.title: An unread call site can be accepted per semantic site via unresolved-allow.json; a second site in the same file/reason class needs its own entry, and stale entries fail

AS-COVER-009.title: A registration whose type is a parameter resolves from its wrapper's call sites when they pass string literals; a same-named function elsewhere is never attributed, and unresolved call sites are still reported

AS-COVER-010.title: A registration is identified through its import binding, so an aliased or namespaced hook is read; a binding the extractor cannot follow is reported unread with a stable reason, and a same-named local function is never attributed

AS-COVER-011.title: A capability every scenario mounted and none could call is reported by inspect, apart from the gate, and never fails the build

AS-COMPILER-001.title: The compiler consumes production static/lazy chunks and virtual modules; aliases resolve by imported compiler-macro identity

AS-COMPILER-002.title: Canonical manifests are byte-identical across checkout paths and contain no runtime volatility

AS-COMPILER-003.title: A second declaration of an existing capability id remains a distinct reviewable declaration

AS-COMPILER-004.title: Dynamic or non-serializable contract construction fails compilation; there is no unresolved bucket

AS-CONTRACT-001.title: Every runtime registration requires compiler proof matching the running authority

AS-CONTRACT-002.title: Compiler manifest, declaration and contract hashes bind static identity to runtime handlers

AS-CONTRACT-003.title: Raw or unknown capabilities cannot widen a strict registry after build

AS-CONTRACT-004.title: Stale manifest hashes and mismatched contract hashes fail closed

AS-AUTHORITY-001.title: Registry construction requires a genuine immutable capability authority

AS-AUTHORITY-002.title: Compiler proof is private and cannot be forged through public object metadata

AS-AUTHORITY-003.title: Authority verifies hashes and registration semantics against source truth

AS-AUTHORITY-004.title: Library adapters cannot replace authority-routed capability execution

AS-EXPOSURE-001.title: The final provider/MCP exposure gateway rejects tools without matching compiler provenance

AS-CLI-015.title: check separates current source/snapshot integrity from snapshot/base PR drift and classifies every structural change

AS-CLI-016.title: Canonical machine, human, Markdown and GitHub output derive from one diff model
